rawText.description:
Raw text to show on the option. This would be a combination of static and dynamic texts.
The dynamic portion would come from user's search input from the dropdown.
Format: Use `${INPUT}` to specify in the rawText string.
e.g. "Create ${INPUT} as a new option"

actionSuffix.description: The action to dispatch when the user selects this option.
